title: Facilities Administrator - Southampton
description:
Morgan Hunt requires a Facilities Administrator for Client based in Southampton Pay Rate: £18ph or £126 per day Ltd Hours 37 8am to 4pm or 9am to 5pm Mon to Fri . Location: Southampton/ South Coast Duration: 6 months on going contractRole Overview:The Facilities Administrator supports the effective delivery of facilities services for all building users through the monitoring the performance and delivery of the Total Facilities Management Contract. Key Responsibilities:1. Support the oversight and management of the Total Facilities Management (TFM) contract. 2. Ensure that the Agency's buildings are safe and compliant through managing the Landlords and the TFM contractor to undertake all the necessary checks and inspections as set out within the contract, 3. Maintain all necessary records and documentation relating to Statutory Inspections and Health & Safety Certification to ensure they are accurate and updated. 4. Complete any day-to-day administration for the delivery of the TFM contract. 5. Maintain the Building Management system to ensure it is up to date. 6. Provide regular reports about the performance of the TFM Contractor 7. Support Building Custodians across the Estate with regard to their duties and responsibilities.8. Provide timely and effective communication to stakeholders and monitor the status of works orders placed to ensure works completed on time and satisfactorily.9. Analyse contract expenditure and the types of works being required to identify trends, areas for investment, improvement and cost reduction. 10.Produce request to purchase documentations, PO's and manage through all systems / processes to ensure timely payment.11. Oversee the delivery and update of the agency's condition survey, ensure all surveys captured within the Building/Asset Management system and work with the Technical Facilities Manager in monitoring and completing any works arising.12. Support in the provision of Facilities Management Services within Spring Place 13. Provide regular reports as required on the TFM Contractors and any other Facilities Contractors performance with regard to compliance reporting, project completion, remedials works etc.14. Manage and update the Facilities Management risk register.Key Requirements:Experience of administering Facilities Management type contracts

Basic knowledge of Health & Safety at Work Act, compliance requirements, building legislation, Construction and Design Management Regulations (CDM), Building Regulations and best practice

Basic knowledge of statutory compliance requirements particularly relating to Fire Risk Assessments (FRA), Legionella Risk Assessments (LRA), Asbestos etc as well as other key estate responsibilities

A good knowledge of Building Management and Maintenance systems together with competent IT skills

Morgan Hunt is a multi-award-winning recruitment Business for interim, contract and temporary recruitment and acts as an Employment Agency in relation to temporary vacancies. Morgan Hunt is an equal opportunities employer, job suitability are assessed on merit in accordance with their skills, qualifications and abilities to perform the relevant duties required in a particular role.

title: Administrator
description:
Are you an organised, proactive individual looking to build a rewarding career in office administration?

Our client is looking for an enthusiastic Logistics Administrator to join their fast-paced team, supporting commercial marine customers. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to transition into a professional office environment, enjoys building strong working relationships, and takes pride in delivering great customer service.

Whether your background is in retail, hospitality, or you already have a touch of basic office experience, full training on the logistics side will be provided. If you have a positive attitude, excellent attention to detail, and a genuine willingness to learn, we would love to hear from you.

The Role

As a Logistics Administrator, you will play a key role in making sure orders get from A to B smoothly. You will:
- Manage Customer Orders: Track and manage orders from the moment they are received through to successful delivery.
- Coordinate & Communicate: Liaise daily with suppliers, customers, and internal teams to keep everything moving efficiently.
- Handle Documentation: Take care of import-related administration and shipping paperwork, keeping accurate records.
- Update Systems: Upload and manage tracking information on customer portals.
- Resolve Queries: Handle customer questions and look into any delivery delays, following issues through to completion.
- Build Relationships: Develop good working relationships with regular clients to ensure a reliable service.
- Learn and Grow: Support continuous team improvements and take on more responsibility as your confidence grows.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is practical, motivated, and enjoys working as part of a busy team. You should bring:
- Clear Communication: A professional phone manner and the ability to write clear, polite emails.
- Strong Attention to Detail: A natural knack for spot-on administration and keeping accurate data.
- Good Time Management: The ability to prioritise tasks effectively and work comfortably to deadlines.
- A Willingness to Learn: You don't need to know the logistics industry yet-you just need a positive attitude and a hunger to learn.
- Problem-Solving Skills: A sensible, customer-focused approach to sorting out issues.

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established and supportive company that genuinely invests in its staff. You will benefit from:
- Structured, step-by-step training on how the industry works.
- Clear opportunities for internal career development.
- Free on-site parking.
- A friendly, collaborative workplace where your contribution is valued.

Your new company

An established engineering and service-led organisation is seeking a highly organised Service Administrator to join its team in Farnborough. Working within a busy operational environment, you'll play a vital role in supporting engineers, Service Managers and customers, ensuring service activity is accurately recorded, communicated and delivered to a high standard. As Service Administrator, you will be responsible for coordinating a wide range of service administration activities to support the day-to-day running of the service department. This is a varied role that requires strong organisational skills, excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Managing shared service inboxes and responding to customer enquiries.
- Logging service calls and ensuring overnight call-outs have been accurately recorded and communicated to Service Managers.

- Producing and distributing engineer service records and service documentation.
- Managing customer portals and maintaining accurate job status updates.
- Monitoring engineer activity and time bookings to ensure records remain accurate.
- Issuing weekly engineer call-out rotas.
- Coordinating customer satisfaction surveys and supporting KPI reporting.
- Sending service sheets and regular updates to customers.
- Liaising with engineers, Service Managers and customers to ensure service information is up to date and accurate.
- Supporting the wider team with additional administrative duties as required.

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous administration experience, ideally within a service, engineering, maintenance, facilities or operational environment.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to prioritise a busy workload.

Administration:
- Operate and have responsibility of a variety of standard office machines including a personal computer, signing in machine, franking machine and badge machine
- Order reception resources as required to include inventory rolls, stamps, signing in machine cards etc
- Enable WiFi connection to external visitors
- Oversee the collection of returned parcels as instructed by the budget holder
- Be point of contact for student exam certification collection in accordance with guidelines

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, confidential and well-organised individual to provide administrative support to the Governance and Executive Support Lead, the Senior Leadership Team and Central Office colleagues. The post holder will support effective communication, meeting administration, office coordination and premises-related administration, helping Central Office run smoothly and professionally.

What You'll Be Doing
- Support the management of Central Office incoming calls, responding professionally and directing calls to the appropriate person or team.
- Deal efficiently and accurately with written and email requests for information, monitoring enquiry emails and ensuring they are responded to, actioned or forwarded as appropriate.
- Ensure visitors to Central Office are greeted professionally, sign in to the building, and are shown appropriate hospitality.
- Provide support by taking and producing accurate minutes of Board and Committee meetings in the absence of the Governance and Executive Support Lead, as and when required.
- Organise room bookings and refreshments, ensuring rooms, equipment and materials are set up as requested. Ensure refreshments are available at the start of meetings and replenished as necessary, and that meeting rooms are cleared and left tidy afterwards
- Provide administrative support to members of the Senior Leadership Team as required, including diary coordination, meeting preparation, document formatting, action tracking and follow-up correspondence.
- Support the Governance and Executive Support Lead with the preparation, formatting, collation and circulation of papers, reports and correspondence, ensuring documents are accurate, professionally presented and shared in a timely manner.
- Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately when supporting senior leaders, trustees, colleagues, residents and external stakeholders.
- Prioritise day-to-day administrative tasks in discussion with the Governance and Executive Support Lead, escalating competing demands or urgent issues where needed.
- Maintain accurate administrative records, trackers and filing systems, ensuring information is stored securely and can be accessed by authorised colleagues when required.
- Distribute incoming post and deliveries, and ensure outgoing post is processed in line with Central Office arrangements.

Key requirements:
- Previous administrative support experience
- Organisational and administrative skills
- Experience of taking minutes and recording clear actions from meetings
- Excellent communication skills, including a professional and helpful telephone manner
- Highly organised and able to manage several tasks in a busy environment and meet deadlines
- Proactive, reliable and collaborative team player, with the ability to work independently
- Experience of office management and people management
- Understanding of health and safety and fire safety regulations in an office environment

What We Offer
- Free Initial DBS check
- Life Assurance
- Blue Light Card
- Not for Profit Care Provider
- Paywise+
- Free parking (subject to availability)
- An Employee Assistance Programme offering 24 hour support for staff and their immediate family members

Who are Brendoncare?

Brendoncare is a charity which provides a range of connected services for people in later life including care homes, extra care housing, community support services and clubs across the South of England.

We are people-driven, focusing on empowerment, inclusivity and understanding. We aim to ensure that whoever comes into the Brendoncare environment - whether as a member, resident, volunteer or colleague - they are able to live their life to the fullest potential.

Our values reflect who we are - together we are kind, empowering, dedicated and forward thinking. We need people who really want to make a difference to the lives of people in later life to join us.

In return, we will support you to grow and flourish as you are welcomed to the Brendoncare team.

Safeguarding is a core priority for us. All successful candidates will be required to undergo an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check as part of our commitment to ensuring a safe and secure environment for everyone.

title: Young Carers Support Coordinator
company: Get Staffed Online Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
Young Carers Support Coordinator (Volunteering Lead)

Winchester, Hampshire (Hybrid)

£22,042 per annum (£27,185 FTE)

Part-Time (30 hours per week to include a Wednesday and Thursday)

Our client is a small independent charity that supports young people who take on caring responsibilities for an unwell or disabled family member. They provide programmes of support to empower Young Carers to look after their physical and emotional wellbeing and have experiences they would otherwise miss out on.

They believe that Young Carers are children first and should be free to develop emotionally and take full advantage of opportunities for educational achievement and life success.

As a Young Carers Support Co-ordinator (Volunteering Lead), you will work as part of a small dynamic team to plan and deliver our client's support programmes for Young Carers. This will include taking responsibility for a specific age group and leading on their programme as well as supporting with other age groups.

This role has three major responsibilities:
- Delivering the Young Carers Exploration Programme, which provides emotional wellbeing support to Young Carers aged 8 - 17.
- Supporting the delivery of the annual activities programme.
- Coordinating the work of volunteers, including recruitment, induction and ongoing professional development.

Key tasks:
- Work as part of a team, leading the weekly delivery of the Charity's term-time Exploration Programme that takes place on Wednesday evenings.
- Support the Young Carer's Support Coordinator Activities Lead in organising and delivering aspects of the Charity's Activity Programme, that takes place on some evenings and during school holidays.
- Coordinate a team of volunteers including their recruitment, training, retainment, supervision and professional development.
- Confidently identify what support is needed for a Young Carer and work with the team to make appropriate referrals to other organisations when necessary.
- Record all interventions with Young Carers into the Charity's database system.
- Take every opportunity to raise awareness of Young Carers and the issues they face with individuals, families, partner organisations, and funding organisations.
- Follow all of the Charity's policies and guidelines, including safeguarding, and lone working and ensure that volunteers adhere to relevant policies.
- Proactively contribute to the wider work of the team by attending relevant team meetings and training as and when required.
- Undertake any other duties as determined by the Manager that are appropriate to the level of this role.

Experience:
- Minimum 18 months experience of working with children and/or young people aged 8 - 18 in an education, youth work, health, social care or voluntary setting.

Skills:
- Ability to organise and work to deadlines.
- Ability to communicate with children, young people and adults.
- Ability to work as part of a small team and be flexible.
- Ability to use own initiative.
- Proficient use IT systems including Databases, Microsoft Word, Spreadsheets etc.

Training and qualifications:
- Relevant training to NVQ 3 or equivalent in a related field (e.g. Youth Work, Health and Social Care, Education).
- Certificate or training in First Aid - desirable.
- Recent safeguarding training - desirable.
- Recent training in behavioural and emotional factors affecting children and young people - desirable.
- Counselling skills - desirable.

This is a great opportunity to work for a well-respected charity. Key benefits include:
- Opportunities for hybrid and flexible working.
- 24 days a year annual leave (pro rata).
- A workplace pension scheme with employer contributions.
- A chance to learn and grow with an organisation that is passionate and creative about its mission.

As part of our client's commitment to safeguarding, please note that this post is subject to an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) and reference checks.
